description: Get the current Project-panel column layout as XML. This is schema/layout configuration, not per-item Scene/Shot/Take values; use inspect_project_panel_metadata_uxp item_columns or get_metadata for those. Output is capped by max_chars (default 20000); when truncated is true the XML is incomplete and must not be passed to set_project_panel_metadata.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of metadata XML to return (256-200000, default 20000). Longer XML is cut at this length and reported with truncated: true and totalChars.

name: get_project_panel_metadata

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Get Project Panel Metadata
